type_pp:
∀ {n : ℕ} (Op : EllipticDirichlet.Sobolev.FullEllipticOp (n + 1)) {Ω : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}
  (hΩm : MeasurableSet Ω),
  IsOpen Ω →
    ∀ (hA : EllipticDirichlet.Regularity.IsC1Coeff Op.toEllipticCoeff),
      (∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), ∀ᵐ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict Ω, Op.b x i = 0) →
        (∀ᵐ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict Ω, 0 ≤ Op.c x) →
          ∀ {V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))} (hVc : IsCompact V),
            V ⊆ Ω →
              ∀ (u : ↥(EllipticDirichlet.Sobolev.H01 Ω)) (f : EllipticDirichlet.Sobolev.L2D Ω),
                (∀ (w : ↥(EllipticDirichlet.Sobolev.H01 Ω)),
                    ((Op.fullBilin Ω) u) w = ∫ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) in Ω, ↑↑f x * ↑↑((↑w).ofLp 0) x) →
                  ∃ C,
                    0 ≤ C ∧
                      ∀ (k i : Fin (n + 1)),
                        ∃ wki,
                          EllipticDirichlet.Regularity.HasWeakDerivOn V k
                              ((EllipticDirichlet.Regularity.restrictL2 ⋯)
                                ((EllipticDirichlet.Regularity.extendL2 hΩm) ((↑u).ofLp i.succ)))
                              wki ∧
                            ‖wki‖ +
                                  ‖(EllipticDirichlet.Regularity.restrictL2 ⋯)
                                      ((EllipticDirichlet.Regularity.extendL2 hΩm) ((↑u).ofLp i.succ))‖ +
                                ‖(EllipticDirichlet.Regularity.restrictL2 ⋯)
                                    ((EllipticDirichlet.Regularity.extendL2 hΩm) ((↑u).ofLp 0))‖ ≤
                              C * (‖f‖ + ‖(↑u).ofLp 0‖)
